claim: The Pile paper (arXiv:2101.00027v1), Appendix C.18, states that its Hacker News component covers story ids from the first Hacker News post through post number 24531712.

verification.evidence_snippet: For the Pile we use the first Hacker News post (1) to post number 24531712. This corresponds to a date range of approximately 10/09/2006 to 09/20/2020.
